_note: Status and headline evidence for the built-in FinSight strategies (public/strategies.js). Only the user may set status to "accepted". Figures from a 2026-10-15 cross-NDX check (survivorship-biased, 10 bps + 5 bps costs). Moves into per-strategy manifests when the strategy plugin migration (spec FS-3) lands.

evidence.source: FinSight strategy library cross-check, NDX universe (2026-10-15)
